evidence: Adding HPO target-phenotype (14,870), Reactome target-pathway (9,253) or STRING target-target (2,387) edges as ordinary message-passing context lowered macro AUPRC
metric: HPO 14,870 edges -> macro 0.934 / micro 0.936; Reactome 9,253 -> 0.938 / 0.941; STRING 2,387 -> 0.936 / 0.939; enriched baseline 0.956 / 0.942; disease-phenotype matches 0
observation: HPO gene-to-phenotype, Reactome and STRING >=700 interactions were downloaded, mapped to existing keys and added to the enriched arm as ordinary message-passing edges. Each run at seed 0 scored below the 0.956 enriched baseline, so the assistant concluded external sources must not be dumped in as undifferentiated adjacency and should instead act as edge-level evidence, source-independence features, pruning inputs or a relation-aware model. Only 3 of 1,160 MONDO disease keys matched HPO disease rows, so the HPO mapping went through gene symbols instead (603 translations, 14,870 edges).
subject: F-15
title: Raw external edges lowered link-prediction AUPRC
